ervice:_finishCemeteryFilm()
	if self.state ~= self.State.CEMETERY_FILM then
		return
	end
	self:_setState(self.State.CEMETERY_DIALOG)
	setTalkBubble(self.npc, "❗", true)
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_handleFinishCemeteryTalk(player)
	if self.state ~= self.State.CEMETERY_DIALOG or player ~= self.owner then
		return
	end
	if not self:_isPlayerNearNpc(player, 16) then
		return
	end
	self.completionDay = self.dayValue.Value
	self:_setState(self.State.WAITING_NEXT_DAY)
	local completed = self.stage2Building and self.stage2Building:FindFirstChild("已完成")
	if completed and completed:IsA("BoolValue") then
		completed.Value = true
	end
	setTalkBubble(self.npc, "…", true)
	self:_tryBeginAftermath()
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_dropOldLetterAt(cframe)
	local letter = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(
		GameEnum.ResItemId.OldLetter,
		cframe * CFrame.new(2, 1, 0)
	)
	if letter then
		letter:SetAttribute("OldCowboyQuestLetter", true)
	end
	return letter
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_convertNpcToCorpse()
	local npc = self.npc
	if not npc or not npc.Parent then
		return nil
	end

	self:_stopEscortStatus()
	setPromptAvailable(npc, false)
	setDialogGuiEnabled(npc, false)
	setTag(npc, GameEnum.Tag.AnimalBuddy, false)
	setTag(npc, GameEnum.Tag.Buddy, false)
	setTag(npc, GameEnum.Tag.EscortTarget, false)
	setTag(npc, GameEnum.Tag.OldCowboyCompanion, false)
	self:_removeForceField()

	npc:SetAttribute("OldCowboyCorpse", true)
	ResourcesItemHelper:InitItem(GameEnum.ResItemId.DeadBody, npc)
	setTag(npc, GameEnum.Tag.PlayerRagdoll, true)

	task.delay(OLD_COWBOY_CORPSE_DURATION, function()
		if not npc.Parent or not npc:GetAttribute("OldCowboyCorpse") then
			return
		end
		local isResource, resource = ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(npc)
		if isResource and resource == npc then
			ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(npc)
		end
	end)
	return npc
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_failEscort()
	if self.state ~= self.State.ESCORT then
		return
	end
	local deathCFrame = self.npc and self.npc:GetPivot() or CFrame.new()
	self:_setState(self.State.FAILED)
	self:_stopAmbushes(false, AMBUSH_FAILURE_CLEANUP_DELAY)
	self.stage1Building:SetAttribute("OldCowboyQuestFailed", true)
	if self.stage2Building then
		self.stage2Building:SetAttribute("OldCowboyQuestFailed", true)
	end
	if self.cemeteryTrigger and self.cemeteryTrigger:IsA("BasePart") then
		self.cemeteryTrigger.CanTouch = false
		self.cemeteryTrigger.CanQuery = false
	end
	self:_stopFeedTouch()
	self:_stopEscortStatus()
	self:_destroyEscortPistol()
	setTag(self.npc, GameEnum.Tag.AnimalBuddy, false)
	setTag(self.npc, GameEnum.Tag.Buddy, false)
	setTag(self.npc, GameEnum.Tag.EscortTarget, false)
	setTag(self.npc, GameEnum.Tag.OldCowboyCompanion, false)
	local ownerValue = self.npc and ValueHelper:FindValue(self.npc, AnimalBuddyValue.ownerPlayer)
	local targetValue = self.npc and ValueHelper:FindValue(self.npc, AnimalBuddyValue.targetEnemy)
	if ownerValue then
		ownerValue.Value = nil
	end
	if targetValue then
		targetValue.Value = nil
	end
	self:_setOwner(nil)
	self:_convertNpcToCorpse()
	self:_dropOldLetterAt(deathCFrame)
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_cloneAftermathScene()
	if not self.stage2Building or not self.stage2Building.Parent then
		return
	end
	local sourceRoot = stage3Prefab:FindFirstChild("RootPart")
	local targetRoot = self.stage2Building:FindFirstChild("RootPart")
	if not sourceRoot or not targetRoot then
		warn("OldCowboyQuest: missing RootPart for aftermath scene")
		return
	end

	local corpseSource = stage3Prefab:FindFirstChild("前辈")
	local corpse = cloneRelative(corpseSource, sourceRoot, targetRoot)
	if corpse then
		corpse:SetAttribute("OldCowboyAftermathRelic", true)
		corpse.Parent = self.stage2Building
	end

	local relicItemIds = {
		["614"] = 614,
		["402"] = 402,
	}
	for markerName, itemId in pairs(relicItemIds) do
		local marker = stage3Prefab:FindFirstChild(markerName)
		if marker then
			local relative = sourceRoot.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(marker:GetPivot())
			local itemCFrame = targetRoot.CFrame * relative
			local item = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(itemId, itemCFrame)
			if item then
				item:SetAttribute("OldCowboyAftermathRelic", true)
				item.Parent = self.stage2Building
			end
		end
	end

	local letterMarker = stage3Prefab:FindFirstChild("old letter")
	if letterMarker then
		local letterRelative = sourceRoot.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(letterMarker:GetPivot())
		local letterCFrame = targetRoot.CFrame * letterRelative
		local letter = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(GameEnum.ResItemId.OldLetter, letterCFrame)
		if letter then
			letter:SetAttribute("OldCowboyQuestLetter", true)
			letter.Parent = self.stage2Building
		end
	end

	local chestMarker = stage3Prefab:FindFirstChild("宝石宝箱")
	if chestMarker then
		local chestRelative = sourceRoot.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(chestMarker:GetPivot())
		local chestCFrame = targetRoot.CFrame * chestRelative
		local chest = GameHelper:CreateTreasureByName("宝石宝箱", chestCFrame, self.stage2Building)
		if chest then
			chest:SetAttribute("RandomId", 8)
			chest:SetAttribute("OldCowboyAftermathRewardChest", true)
		end
	end

	local pointSource = stage3Prefab:FindFirstChild("敌人生成点")
	self.aftermathSpawnPart = cloneRelative(pointSource, sourceRoot, targetRoot)
	if self.aftermathSpawnPart then
		self.aftermathSpawnPart.Name = "暮年牛仔阶段3敌人生成点"
		self.aftermathSpawnPart.Transparency = 1
		self.aftermathSpawnPart.CanCollide = false
		self.aftermathSpawnPart.Parent = self.stage2Building
	end
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_spawnAftermathEnemies()
	if self.state ~= self.State.AFTERMATH or self.aftermathEnemiesSpawned then
		return
	end
	if not self.aftermathSpawnPart then
		return
	end
	self.aftermathEnemiesSpawned = true
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "暮年牛仔阶段3敌人"
	folder.Parent = self.stage2Building
	for _, point in ipairs(self.aftermathSpawnPart:GetChildren()) do
		if not point:IsA("Attachment") then
			continue
		end
		local enemyId = tonumber(point.Name)
		local enemyLo = enemyId and EnemyHelper:GetLo(enemyId)
		if not enemyLo then
			continue
		end
		local enemy
		enemy = EnemyHelper:Create(enemyId,folder)
		if enemy then
			enemy:SetAttribute("OldCowboyAftermathEnemy", true)
			enemy:PivotTo(point.WorldCFrame)
		end
	end
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_beginAftermath()
	if self.state ~= self.State.WAITING_NEXT_DAY then
		return
	end
	self:_setState(self.State.AFTERMATH)
	self:_stopAmbushes(true)
	self:_stopFeedTouch()
	if self.cemeteryTrigger then
		self.cemeteryTrigger:Destroy()
		self.cemeteryTrigger = nil
	end
	if self.npc and self.npc.Parent then
		self:_destroyEscortPistol()
		setTag(self.npc, GameEnum.Tag.AnimalBuddy, false)
		setTag(self.npc, GameEnum.Tag.EscortTarget, false)
		setTag(self.npc, GameEnum.Tag.OldCowboyCompanion, false)
		self.scriptedNpcRemoval = true
		self.npc:Destroy()
	end
	self:_cloneAftermathScene()
	self.stage2Building:SetAttribute("OldCowboyAftermathReady", true)
	if MapHelper:GetBuildingActivity(self.stage2Building) then
		self:_spawnAftermathEnemies()
	end
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_tryBeginAftermath()
	if self.state ~= self.State.WAITING_NEXT_DAY or not self.completionDay then
		return
	end
	if self.dayValue.Value >= self.completionDay + 1 then
		self:_beginAftermath()
	end
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_onBuildingEnter(player, building)
	if building == self.stage1Building then
		self:_spawnStage1Enemies()
	elseif building == self.stage2Building and self.state == self.State.AFTERMATH then
		self:_spawnAftermathEnemies()
	end
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_onBuildingExit(player, building)
	if building ~= self.stage1Building or self.state ~= self.State.RESCUE then
		return
	end
	if not MapHelper:GetBuildingActivity(building) then
		self:_retireStage1Enemies()
	end
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_onAction(player, action)
	if typeof(action) ~= "string" then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	local last = self.lastActionAt[player] or 0
	if now - last < 0.5 then
		return
	end
	self.lastActionAt[player] = now
	if action == "AcceptEscort" then
		self:_handleAcceptEscort(player)
	elseif action == "FinishCemeteryTalk" then
		self:_handleFinishCemeteryTalk(player)
	end
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_onPlayerRemoving(player)
	self.lastActionAt[player] = nil
	if player ~= self.owner then
		return
	end
	self:_setOwner(nil)
	if self.state == self.State.ESCORT or self.state == self.State.CEMETERY_FILM or self.state == self.State.CEMETERY_DIALOG then
		task.defer(function()
			self:_assignReplacementOwner(player)
		end)
	end
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_initialize(stage1Building, spawnBuilding)
	self.stage1Building = stage1Building
	self.spawnBuilding = spawnBuilding
	self.stage1Building:SetAttribute("OldCowboyQuestStage", 1)
	self.npc = stage1Building:FindFirstChild("Old Cowboy")
	assert(self.npc, "OldCowboyQuest: stage 1 is missing Old Cowboy")
	self.actionRemote = self.npc:FindFirstChild("OldCowboyQuestActionC2S")
	if not self.actionRemote then
		self.actionRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		self.actionRemote.Name = "OldCowboyQuestActionC2S"
		self.actionRemote.Parent = self.npc
	end

	self.stage1EnemyFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	self.stage1EnemyFolder.Name = "暮年牛仔阶段1敌人"
	self.stage1EnemyFolder.Parent = self.stage1Building
	self.stage1Points = {}
	self.slotEnemies = {}
	self.retiringEnemies = {}
	self.lastActionAt = {}
	self.claimInProgress = false
	self.aftermathEnemiesSpawned = false
	self.feedHitbox = nil
	self.feedTouchConnection = nil
	self.escortStatusConnections = {}
	self.escortCombatExitGeneration = 0
	self.escortReplyGeneration = 0
	self.escortBubbleText = nil
	self.escortBubbleEnabled = false
	self.ambushGeneration = 0
	self.ambushWave = 0
	self.ambushActive = false
	self.ambushEnemies = {}
	self.ambushFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	self.ambushFolder.Name = "暮年牛仔追杀者"
	self.ambushFolder.Parent = Workspace

	local pointPart = stage1Building:FindFirstChild("敌人生成点")
	assert(pointPart, "OldCowboyQuest: stage 1 is missing enemy spawn points")
	for _, child in ipairs(pointPart:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Attachment") then
			child:SetAttribute("Defeated", false)
			table.insert(self.stage1Points, child)
		end
	end
	table.sort(self.stage1Points, function(a, b)
		return (a:GetAttribute("OldCowboyEnemySlot") or 0) < (b:GetAttribute("OldCowboyEnemySlot") or 0)
	end)

	local prompt = setPromptAvailable(self.npc, false)
	if prompt then
		prompt.ActionText = "Talk"
		prompt.ObjectText = "Old Cowboy"
	end
	local root = getRoot(self.npc)
	if root then
		root.Anchored = true
	end
	self:_ensureForceField()
	setTalkBubble(self.npc, "Help me!😭", true)
	self:_setOwner(nil)
	self:_setState(self.State.RESCUE)

	local controller = GameHelper:GetController()
	self.dayValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(controller, TimeValue.day)

	self.actionRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action)
		self:_onAction(player, action)
	end)
	cemeteryFilmFinishedEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
		if self.state == self.State.CEMETERY_FILM and player == self.owner then
			self:_finishCemeteryFilm()
		end
	end)
	GameHelper.onBuildingEnter.Event:Connect(function(player, building)
		self:_onBuildingEnter(player, building)
	end)
	GameHelper.onBuildingExit.Event:Connect(function(player, building)
		self:_onBuildingExit(player, building)
	end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		self:_onPlayerRemoving(player)
	end)
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function()
		if not self.owner and (self.state == self.State.ESCORT or self.state == self.State.CEMETERY_DIALOG) then
			task.defer(function()
				self:_assignReplacementOwner(nil)
			end)
		end
	end)
	self.dayValue.Changed:Connect(function()
		self:_tryBeginAftermath()
	end)

	local humanoid = getHumanoid(self.npc)
	if humanoid then
		humanoid.Died:Once(function()
			if not self.scriptedNpcRemoval then
				self:_failEscort()
			end
		end)
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		while self.state ~= self.State.FAILED and self.state ~= self.State.AFTERMATH do
			task.wait(2)
			if not self.owner and (self.state == self.State.ESCORT or self.state == self.State.CEMETERY_FILM or self.state == self.State.CEMETERY_DIALOG) then
				self:_assignReplacementOwner(nil)
			end
		end
	end)
end

function OldCowboyQuestService.Start(stage1Building, spawnBuilding)
	if singleton then
		return singleton
	end
	if not stage1Building or not spawnBuilding then
		return nil
	end
	local self = setmetatable({}, OldCowboyQuestService)
	singleton = self
	self:_initialize(stage1Building, spawnBuilding)
	return self
end

return OldCowboyQuestService
"},{"id":347,"text":"local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local ValueHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))
local ResourcesItemHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ResourcesItemHelper"))
local AudioHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("AudioHelper"))
local EffectHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("EffectHelper"))
local GearMechanismSetting = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("ExcelConfig"):WaitForChild("GearMechanismSetting"))

local DragItemValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.DragItemValue
local configById = {}
for _, config in ipairs(GearMechanismSetting.data) do
    configById[config.mechanismId or config.id] = config
end

local boundDoors = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local gearWatchers = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local activeStates = {}

local function addConnection(state, connection)
    table.insert(state.connections, connection)
    return connection
end

local function findPrimaryPart(model, preferredNames)
    if model.PrimaryPart and model.PrimaryPart:IsA("BasePart") then
        return model.PrimaryPart
    end
    for _, name in ipairs(preferredNames or {}) do
        local candidate = model:FindFirstChild(name, true)
        if candidate and candidate:IsA("BasePart") then
            model.PrimaryPart = candidate
            return candidate
        end
    end
    local candidate = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
    if candidate then
        model.PrimaryPart = candidate
    end
    return candidate
end

local function setGearPhysics(model, visible)
    for _, inst in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
            inst.CanCollide = false
            inst.CanTouch = false
            inst.CanQuery = false
            inst.Massless = true
            if not visible then
                inst.Transparency = 1
            end
        end
    end
end

local function prepareDisplay(model)
    findPrimaryPart(model, {"RootPart", "立方体"})
    for _, inst in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
            inst.Anchored = true
            inst.CanCollide = false
            inst.CanTouch = false
            inst.CanQuery = false
            inst.Massless = true
        end
    end
end

local function createRotatingGearMount(gearModel, panelRoot, direction)
    if not gearModel or not gearModel:IsA("Model") then
        return nil
    end

    local gearRoot = findPrimaryPart(gearModel, {"RootPart", "立方体"})
    if not gearRoot then
        return nil
    end

    if not gearModel:GetAttribute("GearMechanismPartsWelded") then
        gearModel:SetAttribute("GearMechanismPartsWelded", true)
        for _, inst in ipairs(gearModel:GetDescendants()) do
            if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
                inst.Massless = true
                inst.CanCollide = false
                inst.CanTouch = false
                inst.CanQuery = false
                if inst ~= gearRoot then
                    local partWeld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
                    partWeld.Name = "GearMechanismGearWeld"
                    partWeld.Part0 = gearRoot
                    partWeld.Part1 = inst
                    partWeld.Parent = gearRoot
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for _, inst in ipairs(gearModel:GetDescendants()) do
        if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
            inst.Anchored = false
            inst.CanCollide = false
            inst.CanTouch = false
            inst.CanQuery = false
            inst.Massless = true
        end
    end

    local motor
    for _, inst in ipairs(panelRoot:GetChildren()) do
        if inst:IsA("Motor6D")
            and inst.Name == "GearMechanismRotationMotor"
            and inst.Part1 == gearRoot then
            motor = inst
            break
        end
    end

    if not motor then
        motor = Instance.new("Motor6D")
        motor.Name = "GearMechanismRotationMotor"
        motor.Part0 = panelRoot
        motor.Part1 = gearRoot
        motor.C0 = panelRoot.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(gearRoot.CFrame)
        motor.C1 = CFrame.new()
        motor.Transform = CFrame.new()
        motor.Parent = panelRoot
    end

    return {
        model = gearModel,
        root = gearRoot,
        motor = motor,
        direction = direction or 1,
    }
end

local function rigidifyPanel(panel, direction)
    local root = findPrimaryPart(panel, {"Union"})
    if not root then
        return nil, {}
    end

    local rotatingGear = panel:FindFirstChild("齿轮")
    local rotatingMounts = {}

    if not panel:GetAttribute("GearMechanismRigidified") then
        panel:SetAttribute("GearMechanismRigidified", true)
        for _, inst in ipairs(panel:GetDescendants()) do
            local belongsToRotatingGear = rotatingGear and inst:IsDescendantOf(rotatingGear)
            if inst:IsA("BasePart") and not belongsToRotatingGear then
                inst.Massless = true
                if inst == root then
                    inst.Anchored = true
                else
                    inst.Anchored = false
                    local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
                    weld.Name = "GearMechanismPanelWeld"
                    weld.Part0 = root
                    weld.Part1 = inst
                    weld.Parent = root
                end
            end
        end
        root.Anchored = true
    else
        root.Anchored = true
    end

    if rotatingGear then
        local mount = createRotatingGearMount(rotatingGear, root, direction)
        if mount then
            table.insert(rotatingMounts, mount)
        end
    end

    return root, rotatingMounts
end

local function attachDisplayToPanel(display, panelRoot, direction)
    return createRotatingGearMount(display, panelRoot, direction)
end

local function findGearModelFromPart(part)
    local current = part
    while current and current ~= workspace do
        if current:IsA("Model") and current:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Gear) then
            return current
        end
        current = current.Parent
    end
    return nil
end

local function rotationOnly(cframe)
    return cframe - cframe.Position
end

local function animateGear(display, startCFrame, targetCFrame, duration, turns, spinAxis, startScale, targetScale, completed)
    local progress = Instance.new("NumberValue")
    progress.Name = "GearMechanismAnimationProgress"
    progress.Value = 0

    local changed = progress.Changed:Connect(function(alpha)
        if not display.Parent then
            return
        end

        local moveAlpha = alpha
        local position = startCFrame.Position:Lerp(targetCFrame.Position, moveAlpha)
        local baseRotation = rotationOnly(startCFrame):Lerp(rotationOnly(targetCFrame), moveAlpha)
        local spinPhase = math.min(moveAlpha / 0.75, 1)
        local spinAngle

        if moveAlpha <= 0.75 then
            spinAngle = math.rad(360 * turns) * spinPhase
        else
            local settleAlpha = (moveAlpha - 0.75) / 0.25
            spinAngle = math.rad(360 * turns) - math.rad(180) * settleAlpha
        end

        display:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position) * baseRotation * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(spinAxis, spinAngle))
        display:ScaleTo(startScale + (targetScale - startScale) * moveAlpha)
    end)

    local tween = TweenService:Create(
        progress,
        TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
        {Value = 1}
    )

    tween.Completed:Connect(function()
        changed:Disconnect()
        if display.Parent then
            display:PivotTo(targetCFrame)
            display:ScaleTo(targetScale)
        end
        progress:Destroy()
        if completed then
            completed()
        end
    end)

    tween:Play()
end

local function animateOpeningGears(rotatingGears, duration, turns, spinAxis)
    if #rotatingGears == 0 then
        return
    end

    local progress = Instance.new("NumberValue")
    progress.Name = "GearMechanismOpeningSpinProgress"
    progress.Value = 0

    local changed = progress.Changed:Connect(function(alpha)
        local spinAngle = math.rad(360 * turns) * alpha
        for _, entry in ipairs(rotatingGears) do
            local motor = entry.motor
            if motor and motor.Parent and motor.Part1 and motor.Part1.Parent then
                motor.Transform = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(spinAxis, spinAngle * entry.direction)
            end
        end
    end)

    local tween = TweenService:Create(
        progress,
        TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
        {Value = 1}
    )

    tween.Completed:Connect(function()
        changed:Disconnect()
        progress:Destroy()
    end)

    tween:Play()
end

local function isResourceInTrigger(resource, trigger)
    local localPosition = trigger.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(resource:GetPivot().Position)
    local triggerHalf = trigger.Size * 0.5
    local resourceHalf = resource:GetExtentsSize() * 0.5
    local halfSize = triggerHalf + resourceHalf
    return math.abs(localPosition.X) <= halfSize.X
        and math.abs(localPosition.Y) <= halfSize.Y
        and math.abs(localPosition.Z) <= halfSize.Z
end

local function connectGearWatcher(item)
    if not item:IsA("Model") or gearWatchers[item] then
        return
    end

    local dragValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(item, DragItemValue.dragPlayer)
    if not dragValue then
        return
    end

    local lastCheck = 0
    local function checkStates()
        if not item:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
            return
        end
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - lastCheck < 0.05 then
            return
        end
        lastCheck = now
        for _, state in ipairs(activeStates) do
            if not state.cleaned and state.tryInstall then
                state.tryInstall(item)
            end
        end
    end

    local connections = {}
    table.insert(connections, dragValue.Changed:Connect(function()
        checkStates()
        if not dragValue.Value then
            task.defer(checkStates)
        end
    end))

    if item.PrimaryPart then
        table.insert(connections, item.PrimaryPart:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(function()
            if dragValue.Value then
                checkStates()
            end
        end))
    end

    table.insert(connections, item.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
        if not parent then
            for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
                connection:Disconnect()
            end
            gearWatchers[item] = nil
        end
    end))

    gearWatchers[item] = connections
    if dragValue.Value then
        checkStates()
    end
end

local function bindDoor(door)
    if not door:IsA("Model") or boundDoors[door] then
        return
    end

    local prefabs = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs")
    if prefabs and door:IsDescendantOf(prefabs) then
        return
    end

    local mechanismId = door:GetAttribute("GearMechanismId")
    local config = mechanismId and configById[mechanismId]
    if not config then
        return
    end

    local gearPrefab = prefabs
        and prefabs:FindFirstChild("Resources")
        and prefabs.Resources:FindFirstChild(tostring(config.gearItemId))
    local doorStructure = door:FindFirstChild("Model")
    local leftDoor = doorStructure and doorStructure:FindFirstChild("左门")
    local rightDoor = doorStructure and doorStructure:FindFirstChild("右门")
    local trigger = door:FindFirstChild("齿轮机关触发区")
    local indicator = door:FindFirstChild("提示灯")

    if not gearPrefab or not gearPrefab:IsA("Model")
        or not leftDoor or not leftDoor:IsA("Model")
        or not rightDoor or not rightDoor:IsA("Model")
        or not trigger or not trigger:IsA("BasePart") then
        warn("[GearMechanismDoorService] Formal workshop door setup incomplete:", door:GetFullName())
        return
    end

    local leftRoot, leftGearMounts = rigidifyPanel(leftDoor, -1)
    local rightRoot, rightGearMounts = rigidifyPanel(rightDoor, 1)
    if not leftRoot or not rightRoot then
        warn("[GearMechanismDoorService] Door panel root missing:", door:GetFullName())
        return
    end

    trigger.Anchored = true
    trigger.CanCollide = false
    trigger.CanTouch = true
    trigger.CanQuery = false
    trigger.Transparency = 1
    door.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Atomic

    local state = {
        door = door,
        config = config,
        leftDoor = leftDoor,
        rightDoor = rightDoor,
        leftRoot = leftRoot,
        rightRoot = rightRoot,
        trigger = trigger,
        indicator = indicator,
        slots = {},
        connections = {},
        installedCount = 1,
        activeAnimations = 0,
        open = false,
        cleaned = false,
        tryInstall = nil,
        rotatingGears = {},
    }
    boundDoors[door] = state
    table.insert(activeStates, state)
    for _, mount in ipairs(leftGearMounts) do
        table.insert(state.rotatingGears, mount)
    end
    for _, mount in ipairs(rightGearMounts) do
        table.insert(state.rotatingGears, mount)
    end

    local function cleanup()
        if state.cleaned then
            return
        end
        state.cleaned = true
        boundDoors[door] = nil
        for _, connection in ipairs(state.connections) do
            connection:Disconnect()
        end
        for index, candidate in ipairs(activeStates) do
            if candidate == state then
                table.remove(activeStates, index)
                break
            end
        end
    end

    addConnection(state, door.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
        if not parent then
            cleanup()
        end
    end))

    local slotCandidates = {}
    for _, panel in ipairs({rightDoor, leftDoor}) do
        local folder = panel:FindFirstChild(config.slotFolderName)
        if folder then
            for _, inst in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                if inst:IsA("Model") then
                    local index = tonumber(inst:GetAttribute(config.slotAttribute))
                    if index then
                        table.insert(slotCandidates, {
                            index = index,
                            template = inst,
                            panel = panel,
                            panelRoot = panel == leftDoor and leftRoot or rightRoot,
                        })
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(slotCandidates, function(a, b)
        return a.index < b.index
    end)

    if #slotCandidates < config.requiredAdditional then
        warn("[GearMechanismDoorService] Missing formal gear slots:", door:GetFullName())
        cleanup()
        return
    end

    local installedFolder = door:FindFirstChild("已安装齿轮")
    if not installedFolder then
        installedFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
        installedFolder.Name = "已安装齿轮"
        installedFolder.Parent = door
    end

    local function createSlotDisplay(slot)
        local display = gearPrefab:Clone()
        display.Name = "待安装齿轮" .. tostring(slot.index)
        pcall(function()
            CollectionService:RemoveTag(display, GameEnum.Tag.Gear)
            CollectionService:RemoveTag(display, GameEnum.Tag.InBag)
            CollectionService:RemoveTag(display, GameEnum.Tag.NatureResItem)
        end)
        prepareDisplay(display)
        display:PivotTo(slot.targetCFrame)
        for _, inst in ipairs(display:GetDescendants()) do
            if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
                inst.Transparency = 1
            end
        end
        display.Parent = installedFolder
        return display
    end

    local slotByIndex = {}
    for _, slot in ipairs(slotCandidates) do
        setGearPhysics(slot.template, true)
        slot.template:SetAttribute("GearInstalled", false)
        slot.template:SetAttribute("GearPlaceholderVisible", true)
        slot.targetCFrame = slot.template:GetPivot()
        slot.occupied = false
        slot.installing = false
        slot.display = createSlotDisplay(slot)
        table.insert(state.slots, slot)
        slotByIndex[slot.index] = slot
    end

    door:SetAttribute("InstalledGears", state.installedCount)
    door:SetAttribute("RequiredGears", 1 + config.requiredAdditional)
    door:SetAttribute("DoorOpen", false)

    local function setIndicatorState(isGreen, tweenDuration)
        local color = isGreen and Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
        local stateName = isGreen and "Green" or "Red"
        door:SetAttribute("DoorIndicatorState", stateName)

        if not indicator then
            return
        end

        local info = TweenInfo.new(tweenDuration or 0, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
        for _, inst in ipairs(indicator:GetDescendants()) do
            if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
                if tweenDuration and tweenDuration > 0 then
                    TweenService:Create(inst, info, {Color = color}):Play()
                else
                    inst.Color = color
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function setPanelCollision(panel, enabled)
        for _, inst in ipairs(panel:GetDescendants()) do
            if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
                inst.CanCollide = enabled
            end
        end
    end

    setIndicatorState(false, 0)
    door:SetAttribute("DoorAnimationComplete", false)

    local function openDoor()
        if state.cleaned or state.open or state.installedCount < 1 + config.requiredAdditional or state.activeAnimations > 0 then
            return
        end

        state.open = true
        door:SetAttribute("DoorOpening", true)
        trigger.CanTouch = false
        setPanelCollision(leftDoor, false)
        setPanelCollision(rightDoor, false)
        local indicatorDuration = config.indicatorDuration or 0.25
        setIndicatorState(true, indicatorDuration)
        pcall(function()
            AudioHelper:PlayEffect(config.readySound or "beep", leftRoot)
        end)

        task.delay(indicatorDuration + (config.openDelayAfterGreen or 1.0), function()
            if state.cleaned or not door.Parent then
                return
            end
            door:SetAttribute("DoorOpen", true)
            pcall(function()
                AudioHelper:PlayEffect(config.openSound or "Door", leftRoot)
            end)

            local center = (leftRoot.Position + rightRoot.Position) * 0.5
        local function outwardDirection(root)
            local direction = Vector3.new(root.Position.X - center.X, 0, root.Position.Z - center.Z)
            if direction.Magnitude < 0.01 then
                direction = Vector3.new(root == leftRoot and -1 or 1, 0, 0)
            end
            return direction.Unit
        end

            local leftTarget = leftRoot.CFrame + outwardDirection(leftRoot) * config.openDistance
            local rightTarget = rightRoot.CFrame + outwardDirection(rightRoot) * config.openDistance
            local info = TweenInfo.new(config.openDuration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
            local remaining = 2

            local function completed()
                remaining -= 1
                if remaining == 0 then
                    door:SetAttribute("DoorAnimationComplete", true)
                    door:SetAttribute("DoorOpening", false)
                end
            end

            local leftTween = TweenService:Create(leftRoot, info, {CFrame = leftTarget})
            local rightTween = TweenService:Create(rightRoot, info, {CFrame = rightTarget})
            animateOpeningGears(state.rotatingGears, config.openDuration, config.openSpinTurns or 1.5, config.spinAxis.Unit)
            leftTween.Completed:Connect(completed)
            rightTween.Completed:Connect(completed)
            leftTween:Play()
            rightTween:Play()

        end)
    end

    local function maybeOpenDoor()
        if state.installedCount >= 1 + config.requiredAdditional and state.activeAnimations == 0 then
            openDoor()
        end
    end

    local function validGear(item)
        if not item or not item:IsA("Model") or not item:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
            return nil
        end
        if prefabs and item:IsDescendantOf(prefabs) then
            return nil
        end
        if item:GetAttribute("GearMechanismConsumed") then
            return nil
        end
        if item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.InBag) or not item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Gear) then
            return nil
        end

        local ok, resource = ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(item)
        if not ok or not resource or not resource:IsA("Model") then
            return nil
        end
        local resourceConfig = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(resource)
        if not resourceConfig or resourceConfig.id ~= config.gearItemId then
            return nil
        end

        local dragPlayer = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(resource, DragItemValue.dragPlayer)
        if dragPlayer and not dragPlayer:IsDescendantOf(Players) then
            return nil
        end
        if not isResourceInTrigger(resource, trigger) then
            return nil
        end
        return resource
    end

    state.tryInstall = function(item)
        if state.cleaned or state.open then
            return false
        end

        local slot
        for _, candidate in ipairs(state.slots) do
            if not candidate.occupied and not candidate.installing then
                slot = candidate
                break
            end
        end
        if not slot then
            return false
        end

        local resource = validGear(item)
        if not resource then
            return false
        end

        slot.installing = true
        slot.occupied = true
        slot.template:SetAttribute("GearInstalled", true)
        resource:SetAttribute("GearMechanismConsumed", true)

        local startCFrame = resource:GetPivot()
        local display = slot.display
        if not display or not display.Parent then
            display = createSlotDisplay(slot)
            slot.display = display
        end
        local startScale = display:GetScale()
        local displayTargetScale = startScale
        display.Name = "已安装齿轮" .. tostring(state.installedCount + 1)
        display:PivotTo(startCFrame)
        display:ScaleTo(startScale)
        for _, inst in ipairs(display:GetDescendants()) do
            if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
                inst.Transparency = 0
            end
        end

        pcall(function()
            ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(resource)
        end)

        state.installedCount += 1
        door:SetAttribute("InstalledGears", state.installedCount)
        state.activeAnimations += 1

        pcall(function()
            AudioHelper:PlayEffect(config.installStartSound or "镶嵌", slot.template)
        end)

        animateGear(
            display,
            startCFrame,
            slot.targetCFrame,
            config.installDuration,
            config.spinTurns,
            config.spinAxis.Unit,
            startScale,
            displayTargetScale,
            function()
                if state.cleaned then
                    if display.Parent then display:Destroy() end
                    return
                end
                display:PivotTo(slot.targetCFrame)
                display:ScaleTo(displayTargetScale)
                setGearPhysics(slot.template, false)
                slot.template:SetAttribute("GearPlaceholderVisible", false)
                local mount = attachDisplayToPanel(display, slot.panelRoot, slot.panel == leftDoor and -1 or 1)
                if mount then
                    table.insert(state.rotatingGears, mount)
                end
                slot.installing = false
                slot.display = display
                state.activeAnimations -= 1

                pcall(function()
                    EffectHelper:PlayEffect("火花", slot.targetCFrame.Position, nil, 0.5)
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    AudioHelper:PlayEffect(config.installCompleteSound or "镶嵌2", display)
                end)
                maybeOpenDoor()
            end
        )

        return true
    end

    local function touched(otherPart)
        local item = findGearModelFromPart(otherPart)
        if item then
            state.tryInstall(item)
        end
    end

    addConnection(state, trigger.Touched:Connect(touched))
    addConnection(state, door.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inst)
        if inst:IsA("Model") and inst:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Gear) then
            connectGearWatcher(inst)
        end
    end))

    for _, item in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Gear)) do
        connectGearWatcher(item)
    end
end

CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.Gear):Connect(connectGearWatcher)
CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.GearMechanismDoor):Connect(bindDoor)

workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inst)
    if inst:IsA("Model") and inst:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.GearMechanismDoor) then
        task.defer(bindDoor, inst)
    elseif inst:IsA("Model") and inst:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Gear) then
        task.defer(connectGearWatcher, inst)
    end
end)

for _, door in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.GearMechanismDoor)) do
    bindDoor(door)
end

for _, item in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Gear)) do
    connectGearWatcher(item)
end
"},{"id":348,"text":"local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local ProximityPromptService = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local dialogFacingRemote = ReplicatedStorage
	:WaitForChild("Events")
	:WaitForChild("Game")
	:WaitForChild("NPCDialogFacingC2S")

local NPC_PROMPT_TAG = "NPCprompt"
local TURN_DURATION = 0.25
local RESTORE_DURATION = 0.2
local SESSION_TIMEOUT = 120
local CLEANUP_INTERVAL = 1
local MIN_ALLOWED_DISTANCE = 20
local DISTANCE_PADDING = 10

local sessions = {}
local playerSessions = {}
local lastEndRequestAt = {}
local nextOrder = 0

local function getNpcRoot(npc)
	local root = npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		or npc.PrimaryPart
		or npc:FindFirstChild("Torso")
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return root
	end
	return nil
end

local function resolveNpc(prompt)
	if typeof(prompt) ~= "Instance" or not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
		return nil
	end
	if not prompt:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
		return nil
	end
	if not CollectionService:HasTag(prompt, NPC_PROMPT_TAG) then
		return nil
	end
	if prompt:GetAttribute("DisableDialogFacing") then
		return nil
	end

	local current = prompt.Parent
	while current and current ~= Workspace do
		if current:IsA("Model") then
			local humanoid = current:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
			if humanoid then
				if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(current) then
					return nil
				end
				if current:GetAttribute("DisableDialogFacing") then
					return nil
				end
				return current, humanoid
			end
		end
		current = current.Parent
	end
	return nil
end

local function getAlivePlayerRoot(player)
	if not player or player.Parent ~= Players then
		return nil
	end
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
	local root = character and (character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character.PrimaryPart)
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return nil
	end
	return root
end

local function getAllowedDistance(prompt)
	return math.max(MIN_ALLOWED_DISTANCE, prompt.MaxActivationDistance + DISTANCE_PADDING)
end

local function isPlayerNearPromptNpc(player, prompt, npcRoot)
	local playerRoot = getAlivePlayerRoot(player)
	if not playerRoot then
		return false
	end
	return (playerRoot.Position - npcRoot.Position).Magnitude <= getAllowedDistance(prompt)
end

local function tweenRoot(session, targetCFrame, duration)
	local root = session.root
	if not root or not root:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
		return
	end
	if session.tween then
		session.tween:Cancel()
	end
	root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	local tween = TweenService:Create(
		root,
		TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{CFrame = targetCFrame}
	)
	session.tween = tween
	tween.Completed:Connect(function()
		if session.tween == tween then
			session.tween = nil
		end
	end)
	tween:Play()
end

local function facePlayer(session, player)
	local playerRoot = getAlivePlayerRoot(player)
	local root = session.root
	if not playerRoot or not root or not root:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
		return false
	end

	local targetPosition = Vector3.new(playerRoot.Position.X, root.Position.Y, playerRoot.Position.Z)
	if (targetPosition - root.Position).Magnitude < 0.05 then
		return false
	end

	session.activePlayer = player
	tweenRoot(session, CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, targetPosition), TURN_DURATION)
	return true
end

local function restoreSession(session)
	if sessions[session.npc] == session then
		sessions[session.npc] = nil
	end
	for player in pairs(session.participants) do
		if playerSessions[player] == session.npc then
			playerSessions[player] = nil
		end
	end
	session.participants = {}
	session.activePlayer = nil

	local root = session.root
	if root and root:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
		local restoreCFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position) * session.originalRotation
		tweenRoot(session, restoreCFrame, RESTORE_DURATION)
	elseif session.tween then
		session.tween:Cancel()
		session.tween = nil
	end
end

local function isParticipantValid(session, player, participant, now)
	if participant.expiresAt <= now then
		return false
	end
	if player.Parent ~= Players then
		return false
	end
	if not session.npc:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) or not session.root:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
		return false
	end
	if not participant.prompt:IsDescendantOf(session.npc) then
		return false
	end
	return isPlayerNearPromptNpc(player, participant.prompt, session.root)
end

local function refreshSession(session)
	if sessions[session.npc] ~= session then
		return
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	local invalidPlayers = {}
	local newestPlayer = nil
	local newestOrder = -math.huge

	for player, participant in pairs(session.participants) do
		if isParticipantValid(session, player, participant, now) then
			if participant.order > newestOrder then
				newestOrder = participant.order
				newestPlayer = player
			end
		else
			table.insert(invalidPlayers, player)
		end
	end

	for _, player in ipairs(invalidPlayers) do
		session.participants[player] = nil
		if playerSessions[player] == session.npc then
			playerSessions[player] = nil
		end
	end

	if not newestPlayer then
		restoreSession(session)
		return
	end
	if session.activePlayer ~= newestPlayer then
		facePlayer(session, newestPlayer)
	end
end

local function removePlayerFromSession(player)
	local npc = playerSessions[player]
	local session = npc and sessions[npc]
	playerSessions[player] = nil
	if not session then
		return
	end
	session.participants[player] = nil
	if session.activePlayer == player then
		session.activePlayer = nil
	end
	refreshSession(session)
end

local function beginDialogue(prompt, player)
	local npc, humanoid = resolveNpc(prompt)
	if not npc or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end
	local npcRoot = getNpcRoot(npc)
	if not npcRoot or not isPlayerNearPromptNpc(player, prompt, npcRoot) then
		return
	end

	local previousNpc = playerSessions[player]
	if previousNpc and previousNpc ~= npc then
		removePlayerFromSession(player)
	end

	local session = sessions[npc]
	if session and session.root ~= npcRoot then
		restoreSession(session)
		session = nil
	end
	if not session then
		session = {
			npc = npc,
			root = npcRoot,
			originalRotation = npcRoot.CFrame.Rotation,
			participants = {},
			activePlayer = nil,
			tween = nil,
		}
		sessions[npc] = session
	end

	nextOrder += 1
	session.participants[player] = {
		prompt = prompt,
		expiresAt = os.clock() + SESSION_TIMEOUT,
		order = nextOrder,
	}
	playerSessions[player] = npc
	facePlayer(session, player)
end

ProximityPromptService.PromptTriggered:Connect(function(prompt, player)
	beginDialogue(prompt, player)
end)

dialogFacingRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, prompt)
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (lastEndRequestAt[player] or 0) < 0.05 then
		return
	end
	lastEndRequestAt[player] = now

	local npc = playerSessions[player]
	local session = npc and sessions[npc]
	local participant = session and session.participants[player]
	if not participant or prompt ~= participant.prompt then
		return
	end
	removePlayerFromSession(player)
end)

local function bindPlayer(player)
	player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
		removePlayerFromSession(player)
	end)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	removePlayerFromSession(player)
	lastEndRequestAt[player] = nil
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(bindPlayer)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	bindPlayer(player)
end

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(CLEANUP_INTERVAL)
		local activeSessions = {}
		for _, session in pairs(sessions) do
			table.insert(activeSessions, session)
		end
		for _, session in ipairs(activeSessions) do
			refreshSession(session)
		end
	end
end)
"},{"id":349,"text":"local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local ResourcesItemHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ResourcesItemHelper"))
local ToolHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ToolHelper"))
local ValueHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))

local GunValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.GunValue
local SteamWeaponActionC2S = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("SteamWeaponActionC2S")

local SteamWeaponHeatService = {}

local MAX_HEAT = 100
local COOL_DELAY = 1.25
local COOL_PER_SECOND = 14
local MANUAL_VENT_DURATION = 1.6
local REMOTE_RATE_LIMIT = 0.1

local STATE_NORMAL = "Normal"
local STATE_MANUAL_VENT = "ManualVent"
local STATE_OVERHEATED = "Overheated"

local states = {}

local function now()
	return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
end

local function newState()
	local timeNow = now()
	return {
		heat = 0,
		lastUpdateAt = timeNow,
		coolStartAt = timeNow,
		state = STATE_NORMAL,
		ventEndAt = 0,
		version = 0,
		lastRemoteAt = 0,
		ventTool = nil,
		ventConnection = nil,
	}
end

local function disconnectVentConnection(state)
	if state.ventConnection then
		state.ventConnection:Disconnect()
		state.ventConnection = nil
	end
	state.ventTool = nil
end

local function sync(player:Player, state)
	if not player.Parent then return end
	player:SetAttribute("SteamHeat", state.heat)
	player:SetAttribute("SteamHeatUpdatedAt", state.lastUpdateAt)
	player:SetAttribute("SteamHeatCoolStartAt", state.coolStartAt)
	player:SetAttribute("SteamHeatState", state.state)
	player:SetAttribute("SteamVentEndAt", state.ventEndAt)
end

local function getState(player:Player)
	local state = states[player]
	if not state then
		state = newState()
		states[player] = state
		sync(player, state)
	end
	return state
end

local function completeTimedState(player:Player, state, timeNow:number)
	disconnectVentConnection(state)
	state.version += 1
	state.heat = 0
	state.lastUpdateAt = timeNow
	state.coolStartAt = timeNow
	state.state = STATE_NORMAL
	state.ventEndAt = 0
	sync(player, state)
end

local function updateCooling(player:Player, state, timeNow:number)
	if state.state ~= STATE_NORMAL then
		if state.ventEndAt > 0 and timeNow >= state.ventEndAt then
			completeTimedState(player, state, timeNow)
		end
		return
	end

	local coolingFrom = math.max(state.lastUpdateAt, state.coolStartAt)
	if state.heat > 0 and timeNow > coolingFrom then
		state.heat = math.max(0, state.heat - (timeNow - coolingFrom) * COOL_PER_SECOND)
		state.lastUpdateAt = timeNow
		if state.heat <= 0 then
			state.heat = 0
			state.coolStartAt = timeNow
		end
		sync(player, state)
	end
end

local function getItemId(tool:Tool?)
	if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then return nil end
	local itemLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(tool)
	return itemLo and itemLo.id or tonumber(tool.Name)
end

local function getEquippedSteamWeapon(player:Player)
	local tool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(player)
	if SteamWeaponHeatService:IsSteamWeapon(tool) then
		return tool
	end
end

local function beginTimedState(player:Player, state, stateName:string, duration:number, heat:number, ventTool:Tool?)
	local timeNow = now()
	disconnectVentConnection(state)
	state.version += 1
	local version = state.version
	state.heat = math.clamp(heat, 0, MAX_HEAT)
	state.lastUpdateAt = timeNow
	state.coolStartAt = timeNow
	state.state = stateName
	state.ventEndAt = timeNow + duration
	state.ventTool = ventTool

	if stateName == STATE_MANUAL_VENT and ventTool then
		state.ventConnection = ventTool.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
			if state.state == STATE_MANUAL_VENT and ventTool.Parent ~= player.Character then
				SteamWeaponHeatService:CancelVent(player)
			end
		end)
	end

	sync(player, state)
	task.delay(duration, function()
		if states[player] ~= state then return end
		if state.version ~= version or state.state ~= stateName then return end
		completeTimedState(player, state, now())
	end)
end

function SteamWeaponHeatService:IsSteamWeapon(tool:Tool?)
	local itemId = getItemId(tool)
	return itemId == 614 or itemId == 615
end

function SteamWeaponHeatService:GetWeaponId(tool:Tool?)
	return getItemId(tool)
end

function SteamWeaponHeatService:CanUse(player:Player)
	local state = getState(player)
	updateCooling(player, state, now())
	return state.state == STATE_NORMAL
end

function SteamWeaponHeatService:AddHeat(player:Player, heatAmount:number, overheatDuration:number)
	local state = getState(player)
	local timeNow = now()
	updateCooling(player, state, timeNow)
	if state.state ~= STATE_NORMAL then
		return false
	end

	state.heat = math.clamp(state.heat + heatAmount, 0, MAX_HEAT)
	state.lastUpdateAt = timeNow
	state.coolStartAt = timeNow + COOL_DELAY
	if state.heat >= MAX_HEAT then
		beginTimedState(player, state, STATE_OVERHEATED, overheatDuration, MAX_HEAT, nil)
	else
		sync(player, state)
	end
	return true
end

function SteamWeaponHeatService:BeginVent(player:Player)
	if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then return false end
	local tool = getEquippedSteamWeapon(player)
	if not tool then return false end

	local state = getState(player)
	local timeNow = now()
	updateCooling(player, state, timeNow)
	if state.state ~= STATE_NORMAL or state.heat <= 0 then
		return false
	end

	local reloading = ValueHelper:FindValue(tool, GunValue.reloading)
	if reloading and reloading.Value then
		return false
	end

	beginTimedState(player, state, STATE_MANUAL_VENT, MANUAL_VENT_DURATION, state.heat, tool)
	return true
end

function SteamWeaponHeatService:CancelVent(player:Player)
	local state = getState(player)
	if state.state ~= STATE_MANUAL_VENT then
		return false
	end

	local timeNow = now()
	disconnectVentConnection(state)
	state.version += 1
	state.lastUpdateAt = timeNow
	state.state = STATE_NORMAL
	state.ventEndAt = 0
	sync(player, state)
	return true
end

function SteamWeaponHeatService:Reset(player:Player)
	local oldState = states[player]
	if oldState then
		disconnectVentConnection(oldState)
	end
	local state = newState()
	states[player] = state
	sync(player, state)
end

local function bindCharacter(player:Player, character:Model)
	SteamWeaponHeatService:Reset(player)
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
	if humanoid then
		humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
			SteamWeaponHeatService:Reset(player)
		end)
	end
end

local function bindPlayer(player:Player)
	getState(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		bindCharacter(player, character)
	end)
	if player.Character then
		task.defer(bindCharacter, player, player.Character)
	end
end

SteamWeaponActionC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player:Player, action:string)
	if typeof(action) ~= "string" then return end
	local state = getState(player)
	local timeNow = now()
	if timeNow - state.lastRemoteAt < REMOTE_RATE_LIMIT then return end
	state.lastRemoteAt = timeNow

	if action == "BeginVent" then
		SteamWeaponHeatService:BeginVent(player)
	elseif action == "CancelVent" then
		SteamWeaponHeatService:CancelVent(player)
	end
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(bindPlayer)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local state = states[player]
	if state then
		disconnectVentConnection(state)
	end
	states[player] = nil
end)

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	task.defer(bindPlayer, player)
end

return SteamWeaponHeatService
